entities.summary: Anthony Hamilton Jones is an American retired professional basketball player. He was a 6-foot-6-inch (198 cm) 195 pounds (88 kg) swingman and played collegiately at Georgetown University from 1981 to 1983, and at University of Nevada, Las Vegas from 1984 to 1986. He played in the National Basketball Association (NBA) from 1986 to 1990.
